checks.text: The page heading is "Attendance Tracker" and the table shows the text "No entries yet".

Typing "Alice" in the field labelled "Name", "2024-01-15" in the field labelled "Date", and selecting "Present" in the select labelled "Status", then clicking "Add entry" adds a row containing "Alice", "2024-01-15", and "Present"; the text "No entries yet" is gone.

After adding Alice (Present, 2024-01-15), typing "Bob" in "Name", "2024-01-15" in "Date", selecting "Absent" in "Status", and clicking "Add entry" adds a row containing "Bob", "2024-01-15", and "Absent"; the table now has two rows.
Clicking "Add entry" with an empty "Name" field adds no row and shows the message "Name is required".
Clicking the button "Delete Alice" removes the Alice row; the table now shows only the Bob row and the summary "Total: 1".
Typing "Alice" in the search box labelled "Search" filters the table to show only the row containing "Alice"; the Bob row is hidden.
Clicking the column header "Date" sorts the table by date ascending; the first row shows the earliest date among visible entries.
Clicking the button "Export CSV" copies a CSV string to the clipboard that starts with "Name,Date,Status" and contains a line "Alice,2024-01-15,Present".
Reload keeps the entry for Alice: after reloading, the table still shows a row containing "Alice", "2024-01-15", and "Present".
